rules.name: no_destructive_without_dry_run
rules.description: Any task using a destructive tool must have a dry-run task as a prerequisite in the DAG
rules.check: if task.tools_required contains destructive_tool then task.inputs must contain dry_run_task_output

rules.name: no_secrets_in_plan
rules.description: Task descriptions and constraints must not contain secret values

rules.name: bash_standard_compliance
rules.description: All bash tasks must declare set -euo pipefail, ERR trap, and explicit binary paths
rules.check: coder executor linter gate (ShellCheck + pattern check)

rules.name: binary_isolation_required
rules.description: Executor tasks must not rely on ambient $PATH; resolve venv/binary paths deterministically
rules.check: no bare tool invocations without explicit path resolution in task constraints

rules.name: domain_tag_required
rules.description: Every task must carry at least one canonical domain_tag from taxonomy.json
rules.check: deterministic lookup against taxonomy.json aliases + canonicals

rules.name: four_pillar_cognition_required
rules.description: Every agent message must include a substantive cognition block with all four pillars (analysis, risks, solution, verification)
rules.check: all 4 fields present AND length >= 30 chars each AND disallow placeholder evasion ('none', 'n/a', 'ok', 'null', 'not applicable')
